newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists make no bids for Italy 3, 5-yr Btps.
newsitem.headline: Specialists make no bids for Italy 3, 5-yr Btps.

text.p: Specialist bond traders made no bids for 200 billion lire of five-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) on offer from the Italian Treasury.
They also made no bids for 200 billion lire of three-year Btps on offer.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.125 trillion lire of three year Btps and 3.720 trillion of five-year paper at an open auction against 2.0 trillion on offer in each auction.
The auction price was set at 100.75 for the three-year paper and 101.85 for five year paper, compared with 100.40 and 101.20 respectively at the previous auction.
